label: verify-t3-lumen-crit

claims.claim: Genotype is fully confounded with imaging session; WT residuals vary by session (p=0.0025, ICC 0.355, SD of session means 0.074), so the +-0.05 and -0.03 thresholds are below batch noise.
claims.source_says: wt_residual_anova_by_date p 0.00249, F 4.24; icc_date 0.3554; between_session_sd 0.0737. Cldn_qKO files all start 200130_26/27/28; WT 170130..180123; Rab11a 201019, 20201120, 201201.
claims.note: I re-ran the scripts and file listing; numbers match, and 0.074 exceeds 0.05 and 0.03, though sessions are inferred from filename dates.

claims.claim: Design identity 2 is inverted; a = (N l_b)^2 IPQ_cyst/(4 pi) - N holds to 1.8e-14 while the written form errs by up to 3.23.
claims.source_says: identity2_correct_form maxabs_err 1.776e-14; identity2_as_written maxabs_err 3.226 (median 0.482) over 52 WT rows.
claims.note: Re-running an_wt.py reproduces these; I did not separately open design-lumen.json to confirm its wording.

claims.claim: The WT-derived numbers in the design (0.6703+0.0261N, RMSE 0.124/0.106, ceiling 12.64, counts 43/7, 44/7, 22/2/1) reproduce exactly from the source tables.
claims.source_says: M2_intercept 0.67027, slope 0.02608, RMSE const 0.12433, line 0.10621, ceiling 12.64; WT N3to10 43, Ngt10 7; Rab11a 44/7; Cldn 22 in 3-10, 2 below, 1 above.
claims.note: The recomputation reproduces every listed number; whether the design states the same values was not checked.

claims.claim: P5 and P6 should be dropped (P5: n=15 mixed genotypes, SE 0.022, WT part seen; P6: Zenodo has example images only); P3 and P4 should be exploratory.
claims.source_says: Zenodo files: intensity_data.zip 76144, readme.txt 599, example_raw_imaging_data.zip 7467521. 'Full raw imaging data is available from the authors on reasonable request.'
claims.note: Zenodo facts hold, but it also has an intensity_data.zip, so 'example images only' is slightly loose, and the drop/exploratory advice is a judgment.

overall: The numeric claims reproduce: I re-ran the scripts and the filename and Zenodo listings and the figures match. The only deduction is for loose wording on the Zenodo record, and the recommendations are judgments.
